title: Keep the complete installed runbook in shared operational memory
summary: Owner clarified that GitHub is read at install or explicit upgrade, while every routine turn must recover all requirements, stages and role instructions from the master spreadsheet itself.
outcome: Added full-text instruction packets, version-bound operational config, staged/readback activation and a repository-free startup loader. Separate Review and QA each passed 11 targeted tests with no open material findings. Live memory installation remains for the deployed agent; publication is separately authorized by the owner.
decisions: Store all seven full instruction components and the operational configuration in the same master shared-memory container, rather than saving only source links.
Bind method text and configuration snapshot to one revision/hash manifest so upgrade and rollback select a consistent pair.
Read the source repository only at installation or explicit upgrade; routine startup reads the active memory revision and relevant state/checkpoint/events.
Preserve previous instruction/config revisions and book data; incomplete memory blocks dependent work instead of inventing a procedure from chat.
next_actions: Publish the tested version 2 package following the owner's authorization and verify the remote commit and CI.
Have the deployed agent perform the documented installation/upgrade and read back the complete method/config in its own private master sheet.
